Initial release of Text to Video Free Trial — Create Videos from Text Free:

- Instantly generate shareable 1080p videos from text prompts, TXT/DOCX/PDF files, or pasted content (up to 200MB)
- Requires no filming or local install; all processing runs on cloud GPUs in 1–2 minutes per video
- Supports user-friendly, keyword-activated commands for upload, export, status, and credit checks
- Delivers high-quality MP4 exports by default, with options for various audio/video/image formats
- Handles session and token management automatically, including free trial tokens and session recovery
- Provides clear error handling and workflow summaries for common edit/batch/iterative tasks
